messages:
alex.dev: Heads up — since rolling out the client-metadata-injection change in py/go SDKs, customers hitting routing-based quotas see double attribution and some Dedicated pools are evicting requests. Repro attached.

alex.dev: Repro (python):
```python
headers = {
  "x-redwood-client": json.dumps({"sdk":"py", "version":"1.5.0", "route_hint":"foo"})
}
response = requests.post(url, headers=headers, json=payload)
```

morgan.platform: Which header name exactly and which SDK versions shipped this? Is this a rollout flag we flipped? :eyes:

priya.sdk: Sorry — my mistake. We landed a change that serializes client metadata into `x-redwood-client` by default in py 1.5.0 and go 0.9.2. The original plan was opt-in, but the default got set to true during the config refactor.

dan.reliability: Seeing it in the console now — route-tag counters spike and we get duplicate rows for the same logical route (one with the old empty meta, one with the new JSON blob). Quotas are charged twice because attribution keys differ. Dashboard: https://console/redwood/dashboards/route-attrib (internal) :warning:

sam.runtime: Runtime tolerates extra headers, but router uses the full header blob as part of the route key. Because JSON keys were not canonicalized, tiny ordering differences create distinct keys. We should canonicalize server-side and treat legacy-empty header as equivalent.

priya.sdk: Proposed immediate actions: 1) flip SDK default back to off and cut patch releases (py 1.5.1, go 0.9.3, ts 2.0.1), 2) server-side shim to normalize/dedupe incoming x-redwood-client for 48–72h, 3) console alert + note in billing. Does that sound right?

morgan.platform: Yes. Priority: server-side shim first (prevents further damage), then the SDK patch. For rollout: canary the shim in us-west-2 then global. Also add an automated conversion that maps the canonical metadata to the prior attribution key so quotas are backfilled to the correct bucket.

alex.dev: Will this require a semver-major? Customers using the header intentionally might be affected. Need compatibility plan.

priya.sdk: No semver-major. We revert the default only (bugfix). If customers depended on the new default behavior, they'll have to opt in. We'll add a clear changelog and an opt-in flag in the next minor. I'll open PRs in py/go/ts and mark as urgent.

dan.reliability: I'll create a support tag and notify billing to prepare manual reconciliations for affected customers. Also, add a Grafana alert for duplicate route keys > 1% of traffic.

deploy-bot: deploy: api-gateway/shim-normalize-x-redwood-client v1.0.0 -> staged/us-west-2 at 2026-03-20T14:05:12Z

priya.sdk: Cutting py patch now, PR: https://git.redwood/p/priya/py-client-patch (will include tests that canonicalize json ordering before sending).

morgan.platform: :thumbsup: Keep this thread updated with PR and rollback windows. We should follow up with a short postmortem and docs note about header semantics.
